item.text: I’ll submit one evidence-based decision for each supplied profile, then verify the batch status.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc './submit_profile "Stella Heemskerk" accept "Exact Stella C. M. Heemskerk at Erasmus MC. Extensive patient-reported-outcome and EQ-5D measurement record, including US EQ-5D valuation, EQ-5D/SF-12 comparison, and the ISPOR report on electronic-versus-paper PRO measurement equivalence." && ./submit_profile "Stevanus Pangestu" accept "Exact Stevanus Pangestu at Corvinus University of Budapest. Recent work directly matches the listed EQ projects: EQ-5D-5L bolt-ons, child/adult EQ-5D-Y-3L composite TTO, EQ-HWB, and health-related quality of life; sustained collaboration with Fanni Rencz supports the identity." && ./submit_profile "Stirling Bryan" accept "Exact Stirling Bryan with a large, coherent health-economics and quality-of-life record.
